+"""Record preparation steps reusing click value conversion helpers."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from click.utils import make_str
+
+
+def display(value: t.Any) -> str:
+    """Convert a value to its display string using click make_str semantics."""
+    return make_str(value)
+
+
+def prepare(record: t.Any) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
+    """Validate a record and return a new prepared copy with a display string."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {
+        "key": key.strip(),
+        "value": value,
+        "display": display(value),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }

diff --git a/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py b/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py
index b44a2f5..cae150b 100644
--- a/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py
+++ b/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py
@@ -31,3 +31,19 @@ def prepare(record: t.Any) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
         "display": display(value),
         "enabled": enabled,
     }
+
+
+def batch(records: t.Any) -> list[dict[str, t.Any]]:
+    """Prepare a list of records in order, rejecting duplicate trimmed keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared: list[dict[str, t.Any]] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate key: {key!r}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

diff --git a/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py b/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py
index cae150b..615e0da 100644
--- a/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py
+++ b/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py
@@ -47,3 +47,12 @@ def batch(records: t.Any) -> list[dict[str, t.Any]]:
         seen.add(key)
         prepared.append(item)
     return prepared
+
+
+def group(records: t.Any) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    """Group display values of enabled records by the first character of their key."""
+    groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return groups

@@ -56,3 +56,11 @@ def group(records: t.Any) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
         if item["enabled"]:
             groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
     return groups
+
+
+def merge(left: t.Any, right: t.Any) -> list[dict[str, t.Any]]:
+    """Merge two record lists; right records replace left ones sharing a key."""
+    merged = {item["key"]: item for item in batch(left)}
+    for item in batch(right):
+        merged[item["key"]] = item
+    return list(merged.values())

@@ -64,3 +64,14 @@ def merge(left: t.Any, right: t.Any) -> list[dict[str, t.Any]]:
     for item in batch(right):
         merged[item["key"]] = item
     return list(merged.values())
+
+
+def report(left: t.Any, right: t.Any) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
+    """Summarize merged records with their groups and counts."""
+    items = merge(left, right)
+    return {
+        "items": items,
+        "groups": group(items),
+        "count": len(items),
+        "enabled": sum(1 for item in items if item["enabled"]),
+    }
